integration_collection_provenance.description: Bounded source summary for a segment built from saved integration matches; null otherwise.

subtype.description: Segment subtype. Determines which additional attributes are present. filter = saved filter criteria; matched = customer list upload with identity resolution; similarity = lookalike model; propensity = ML scoring model.

status.description: pending = computation in progress (matched/similarity/propensity during creation); active = fully ready; failed = workflow or enrichment error (see error_message); archived = hidden from the default segment catalog and new audience compositions, but otherwise fully functional — audiences that already reference an archived segment are unaffected, and it can be restored with PATCH status:active at any time. Distinct from DELETE, which is not reversible and does change referencing audiences' composition; expired = past 90-day TTL.

record_count.description: Total matched/qualified records. Null while pending or if count has not been run.

expires_at.description: Date-only ISO string (90-day hard expiry from creation) for a persistent segment; a full ISO datetime (short, hour-granular TTL) while `ephemeral` is true.

visibility.description: org (default) — visible to all members of the org. private — visible only to the creating user.

current_version.description: filter subtype only. Current version counter.

record_limit.description: filter subtype only — membership cap; null when uncapped (see POST /v1/segments)

filter_groups.description: filter subtype only. Complete saved definition; a single AND group represents a flat input.

file_format.description: matched subtype only. Input file format.

compression.description: matched subtype only. Input artifact compression, normalized to none by current handlers.

shard_count.description: matched subtype only. Number of same-format input objects, normalized to 1 for unsharded uploads.

column_mappings.description: matched subtype only. Source column name → standard identity attribute mappings. Populated after the analyze-and-store workflow gate runs.

mapping_confirmed.description: matched subtype only. True once column mappings have been confirmed.

input_record_count.description: matched subtype only. Number of rows in the original upload.

match_count.description: matched subtype only. Rows that resolved to a known identity after enrichment.

upload_url.description: matched subtype only. 30-minute signed upload URL. Present on create and refresh responses only, when shard_count was 1 (the default) — absent when sharded, use upload_urls instead.

upload_urls.description: matched subtype only. N signed upload URLs (index-ordered). Present on create and refresh responses only when shard_count > 1 was requested — upload_url is absent. Every CSV shard must include the same header row.

upload_expires_at.description: matched subtype only. Expiry of upload_url/upload_urls.

error_message.description: Present when status is failed. Describes the reason for failure.

source_data_segment_id.description: matched subtype only. Opaque, read-only reference to stored match results when they are shared or versioned independently from the segment metadata. Null when no separate result reference is needed.

seed_description.description: similarity subtype only. Natural language ICP persona description used as seed.

seed_segment_id.description: similarity subtype only. ID of an existing segment used as the lookalike seed.

workflow_run_id.description: similarity and propensity subtypes. The workflow run ID. Poll GET /v1/workflows/{workflow_run_id} to monitor progress.

positive_class_segment_id.description: propensity subtype only. ID of the segment whose members are the positive training class.

parent_segment_id.description: ID of the segment this was duplicated or derived from, if applicable.

derived_from.description: Root ancestor segment ID. Stable across duplicate-of-duplicate chains — always points at the original segment, never an intermediate duplicate.

parent_segment_version.description: Version of the parent segment pinned at duplicate time (current_version for filter parents; snapshot_version otherwise). Null on segments that are not duplicates.

origin_campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign whose chat session first produced this segment. Metadata only — does not restrict the segment to that campaign. Present only when the segment was created via POST /v1/segments with a campaign_id.

usage.description: Cross-campaign usage stats. Only present on GET /v1/segments/{id} — not included on list responses. Useful for understanding impact before archiving.

audience_count.description: Number of active audiences that reference this segment.

campaign_count.description: Number of distinct campaigns those audiences belong to.

EnrichmentRelease.description: Delivered IAG refresh version. Independent of license status. Null provenance means unknown; a newer refresh-major can prompt a refresh through existing workflows. Active licenses and existing identity IDs support free refresh; normal charges may apply otherwise.

Filter.description: A single filter condition for audience discovery or job execution

field.description: Canonical catalog field_name (e.g. age or state). ZIP5 also accepts zip, zip_code, or postal_code as input aliases; saved responses use zip5.

text_comparison.description: Optional STRING comparison mode for =, !=, IN, NOT IN, and LIKE, or ARRAY<STRING> membership mode for ARRAY_CONTAINS and ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY. Defaults to exact. Case-insensitive mode applies Unicode case folding to both the stored value and the supplied value.

trim_whitespace.description: Optionally trim leading and trailing whitespace on both sides of a STRING or ARRAY<STRING> comparison. Defaults to false; independent of text_comparison.

value.description: The value to match against. For state, a published two-letter code or full State name is accepted and normalized to the code. Scalar types (`string`, `number`, `boolean`) are used for single-value operators (`=`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `LIKE`, `ARRAY_CONTAINS`). Pass an **array** for `IN`, `NOT IN`, and `ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY` — pass the array directly with no comma-encoding. `BETWEEN` takes a two-element array `[low, high]`. Omit entirely for `IS NULL` / `IS NOT NULL` checks.

FilterGroup.description:
A group of Filter conditions. All `filters` within a single group are **always ANDed together** — there is no per-group intra-operator. The `combinator` attribute is an **inter-group** operator: it controls how this group is joined to the immediately preceding group in the array. The `combinator` on the first group (index 0) is always ignored.

Example — `(city = "NYC" AND state = "NY") OR (state = "CA")`:
```json [
  { "id": "g1", "filters": [{"field":"city","op":"=","value":"NYC"},
                            {"field":"state","op":"=","value":"NY"}],
    "combinator": "AND" },
  { "id": "g2", "filters": [{"field":"state","op":"=","value":"CA"}],
    "combinator": "OR" }
] ```
Group g1's `combinator` is irrelevant (it is the first group). Group g2's `combinator: "OR"` means the result is `(g1) OR (g2)`.

id.description: Stable identifier (UUID or NanoID). Used to track groups across edits.

filters.description: One or more filter conditions. All conditions in this array are combined with AND. Provide at least one filter per group.

combinator.description: **Inter-group operator.** Joins this group to the previous group in the array. `AND` narrows the result; `OR` broadens it. Ignored on the first group (index 0) — that group has no predecessor to join.
